testSuite.details: 174 tests, 0 failures, 0 skipped, 100% successful (20.744s). Includes new RememberMeWebSessionIdResolverTest (10 tests, Scenarios A-H + cookie-name pass-through + bonus regression) and extended AuthServiceTest cases (login true/false attribute writes) and AuthServiceRegistrationTest (register auto-login attribute=false).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-1: POST /api/auth/login {rememberMe:true} → Set-Cookie with Max-Age=2592000 and Expires ~+30 days; other flags from config preserved
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: smoke.log: Set-Cookie: SESSION=...; Max-Age=2592000; Expires=Mon, 08 Jun 2026 13:26:15 GMT; Path=/; HTTPOnly; SameSite=Lax (today=2026-05-09, +30 days = 2026-06-08)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-2: POST /api/auth/login {rememberMe:false} → Set-Cookie WITHOUT Max-Age and WITHOUT Expires (session cookie)
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: smoke.log: Set-Cookie: SESSION=cc32e3ad-...; Path=/; HTTPOnly; SameSite=Lax (no Max-Age, no Expires)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-3: server-side TTL in Mongo stays in sync with cookie (24h vs 30d)
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Covered by RememberMeWebSessionIdResolverTest Scenario E (parameterized over app.session.ttl-remember-me-days) + AuthServiceTest verifies WebSession.maxIdleTime. All passed in test suite (./gradlew :backend:test → 174/174).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-4: pre-fix cookie (no Max-Age) with valid id in Mongo sessions still authorizes /api/auth/me → 200 OK
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: smoke.log: GET /api/auth/me with header `Cookie: SESSION=cc32e3ad-...` (raw name=value, no attributes) → HTTP/1.1 200 OK, body {id, email, name, status} returned. Existing sessions are not invalidated by deploy.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-5: POST /api/auth/logout → Set-Cookie with Max-Age=0 regardless of rememberMe state
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: smoke.log: POST /api/auth/logout (CSRF-protected, used XSRF-TOKEN cookie jar) → Set-Cookie: SESSION=; Max-Age=0; Expires=Sat, 09 May 2026 13:26:55 GMT; Path=/; HTTPOnly; SameSite=Lax

Inline during fresh-user registration: POST /api/auth/register {email:qa-task5@example.com, password:...} → 201 Created with Set-Cookie: SESSION=6d637f98-...; Path=/; HTTPOnly; SameSite=Lax (no Max-Age, no Expires).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-7: re-login flipping rememberMe (true → false or vice versa) rewrites cookie attributes without manual action
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: smoke.log: same cookie jar, first login {rememberMe:true} → Max-Age=2592000; second login {rememberMe:false} on the same jar → Set-Cookie: SESSION=d20e9d2a-...; Path=/; HTTPOnly; SameSite=Lax (new session id, no Max-Age — cookie rewritten).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-8: SERVER_REACTIVE_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME=ALT env var + restart → Set-Cookie writes cookie with name ALT; fix code unchanged
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Backend restarted with `SERVER_REACTIVE_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME=ALT ./gradlew bootRun`. smoke.log: POST /api/auth/login {rememberMe:true} → Set-Cookie: ALT=78831631-...; Max-Age=2592000; Expires=Mon, 08 Jun 2026 13:28:59 GMT; Path=/; HTTPOnly; SameSite=Lax. Cookie name flipped from SESSION to ALT via env alone, no code changes.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Manual browser smoke (user-spec 'Пользователь проверяет'): persist via browser restart with checkbox, session-only without checkbox, logout clears cookie
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: User-confirmed on 2026-05-09 against http://localhost:3000 (Nuxt dev) + http://localhost:8080 (backend default config). All three scenarios verified: persist via browser restart with checkbox; session-only behavior without checkbox; logout removes SESSION cookie from DevTools list.
